brief.title: AI Impact on the Global Job Market: Risk, Salary & Skills Trend Analysis (2015–2035)
brief.one_liner: A comprehensive trend analysis examining how AI automation risk, salary dynamics, skill demand, and job survival prospects are evolving across roles, countries, and experience levels from 2015 to 2035.
brief.goal: Equip executive leadership and workforce strategists with data-driven insights into which job categories face the highest automation risk, how salaries and job openings are shifting over time, and which skills and education profiles offer the strongest future-proofing — enabling informed decisions on talent investment, reskilling programs, and strategic workforce planning.

required_sections.title: Executive Overview
required_sections.objective: Provide a high-level summary of the dataset scope and the most critical findings regarding AI's impact on jobs, salaries, and skills across the 2015–2035 horizon.

required_sections.title: AI Automation Risk Landscape
required_sections.objective: Analyze the distribution of AI risk scores and risk categories across job titles, countries, and experience levels. Identify the roles and regions most and least vulnerable to automation.

required_sections.title: Salary Trends & Segmentation
required_sections.objective: Examine salary evolution over time by country, job title, experience level, and education level. Highlight salary bucket distributions and how compensation correlates with AI risk.

required_sections.title: Skills Demand & Future-Proofing
required_sections.objective: Identify which primary skills have the highest and fastest-growing demand scores, and assess how skill demand relates to job survival classification and AI risk.

required_sections.title: Job Survival & Market Outlook
required_sections.objective: Analyze job survival class distributions and job opening trends over time. Determine which combinations of role, skill, education, and geography yield the strongest job survival prospects through 2035.

required_sections.title: Strategic Recommendations
required_sections.objective: Synthesize findings into actionable recommendations for workforce planning, reskilling investment, and talent acquisition strategy.

kpis.name: Average AI Risk Score
kpis.description: Mean ai_risk_score across all records, segmented by job title, country, and year to track automation threat trends.

kpis.name: Median Salary
kpis.description: Median salary value segmented by year, country, experience level, and job title to capture compensation trends.

kpis.name: Job Survival Rate
kpis.description: Proportion of records classified as surviving (job_survival_class >= 1) versus at-risk (job_survival_class = 0), tracked over time.

kpis.name: Average Skill Demand Score
kpis.description: Mean skill_demand_score by primary skill and year, indicating which competencies are gaining or losing market relevance.

kpis.name: Total Job Openings Trend
kpis.description: Aggregate job_openings by year and job title to reveal expanding or contracting labor demand.
